commands.review_summary:
The branch stacks on the gateway HTTP repair slice, adds non-mutating review-required Policy doctor previews for Gateway bind and node-command findings, and preserves skipped preview changes in doctor repair output.

PR surface: Source +163, Tests +180, Docs +4. Total +347 across 9 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection against PR head reproduces the docs mismatch: the code adds skipped review-required previews for two Gateway checks while the Policy CLI Repair section only documents automatic repairs and manual URL-fetch allowlists.
commands.review_followup: - A single docs update can resolve the actionable review finding; merge sequencing still waits on draft and lower-stack maintainer review.

target.title: policy: preview review-required gateway repairs
target.body:
## Summary

- Restack on current #99731 after #99720 merged and #99731 was cleaned up.
- Add review-required `doctor --fix` previews for Gateway policy findings that should not be auto-mutated:
  - `policy/gateway-non-loopback-bind`: previews setting `gateway.bind=loopback` for both `gateway.bind` and `gateway.customBindHost` non-loopback findings.
  - `policy/gateway-node-command-denied`: previews appending the missing command to `gateway.nodes.denyCommands`.
- Preserve skipped repair preview `changes` in the structured repair flow so review-required guidance is visible without counting the check as repaired.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` now surfaces review-required preview guidance for Gateway bind and Gateway node-command policy findings without mutating config or counting the check as repaired.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-policy-review-previews-push`, source checkout at PR head `40089645`, based on current #99731 head `c644a16a5d8ddfbd925943d5e8bc49e6738829f2`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD`
2. `rg -n "<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>" extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/review-required-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.ts`
3. `git diff --stat origin/policy-doctor-gateway-http-repairs...HEAD`
4. `git diff --name-status origin/policy-doctor-gateway-http-repairs...HEAD`

Evidence after fix:
`git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` exited 0. Conflict marker search returned no matches. The final PR diff is five files, 278 insertions and 3 deletions: `review-required-repairs.ts`, gateway scope repair hooks, policy doctor preview tests, and repair-flow skipped-preview propagation. The included tests cover non-loopback `gateway.bind`, non-loopback `gateway.customBindHost`, denied node-command previews, non-previewable findings without repair registration, and skipped repair preview `changes` surfacing through the repair flow.

Observed result after fix:
The preview repair returns `status: skipped`, reason `policy repair requires review before changing config`, review warning/change text, and dry-run-safe config effects; it does not return a mutated config.

What was not tested:
This clean push worktree has no `node_modules`, so I did not rerun Vitest locally after the restack. GitHub CI is running on the pushed PR head.

## Stack

- Stacked on #99731.
- Keep draft until #99731 lands, then restack directly onto `main` and mark ready.
